_comment: Tier-2 for sparta adaptive_grid and hypersonic_flow: 'fix adapt' refines without limit unless 'maxlevel' caps it, and nothing warns. Two decks were run on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial) differing only by the trailing 'maxlevel 2' on one 'fix adapt 100 all refine particle 5 0' line. Uncapped, Ngrid climbs on every stats line and Maxlevel reaches 3 while Np is identical on all seven lines and the per-cell particle MINIMUM falls from above one to zero and the per-cell average more than halves — so the very quantity driving the adaptation has become noise. Capped, Maxlevel never exceeds 2 and Ngrid saturates. Both runs exit 0 with no error and no warning, which is the point: this is a silent failure. Every assertion is a column shape (flat, climbing, saturating) or a comparison between the two decks; no cell count is pinned, because the counts a refinement produces depend on the seed and the particle distribution. COVERS: adaptive_grid:2, hypersonic_flow:5.
